verdict.rationale: WezTerm's own docs show color scheme support: "true color and dynamic color schemes" and changing the color scheme through the config file, which reloads automatically when edited. Nothing in the pack documents automatic light/dark switching tied to the OS appearance; "dynamic color schemes" is too vague to count as that. missing for 10: documented automatic light/dark mode switching, details on the color scheme catalog and theme configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of theming.
